find: Mori Shade knew my name before I gave it at her parlour door, and she knew what an honest ledger requires.
replace: Mori Shade knew my name before I gave it at her door, and she knew what an honest ledger requires.
why: Her shop is a funeral home, not a parlour.

find: Rook turns back toward the dark beyond the wagons, standing quiet at parade rest.
replace: Rook turns back toward the dark beyond the firelight, standing quiet at parade rest.

find: OPTION 3: Say nothing and give him room by the fire.
replace: OPTION 3: Say nothing. Stay by the fire.
why: Option text is the party's words or action, not a stage direction about him.

find: I'll keep my post and my halberd in line, never fret.
replace: I'll keep my post and my shield in line, never fret.
why: No halberd in the canon (a joke in the note only).

find: his hands settlin' square on the rim of his shield
replace: his hands settling square on the rim of his shield
why: Fewer dropped g's (one Narrator row in four).

find: sets it neatly beside his halberd.
replace: sets it neatly beside his shield.

find: the noise sounded dead ringer for a glacial trench caving in.
replace: it sounded for all the world like a trench caving in.

find: Thought for a long count it was the man I left under the ice up in Syndramas, come to audit the badge on my coat.
replace: Thought for a long count it was something I left behind a long way north, come to audit the badge on my coat.
why: The dark secret (the man left under the ice) is Raum's gate's to tell: a hint only.

find: Wasn't his voice at all, when I stood my ground and listened past the draught in the flues.
replace: Wasn't anybody else's at all, when I stood my ground and listened past the draught in the flues.

find: It was my own voice from the ditch, calling for a shovel I never went back to fetch while another man held the timber.
replace: It was my own voice from a ditch up north, calling for a shovel.

find: OPTION 1: Tell me about the man who held the timber.
replace: OPTION 1: Tell me what you heard in there.
why: The option presupposed the dark secret.

find: He was a stonemason's lad with a clean chisel hand, and he kept his post to the end. There are two pages left to fill before his whole file is squared.
replace: A voice from a ditch a long way north, and a debt I won't name tonight. Two pages left to fill before the file is squared.
why: The man behind the dark secret is not named or described.

find: REASON: You asked to hear about the man I left under the ice.
replace: REASON: You asked what I heard in there.

find: the brass knocker on his shield restin' quiet against his knee.
replace: the brass knocker on his shield resting quiet against his knee.

find: where a red ink blot shows through the lining.
replace: where the calfskin has gone soft with damp.
why: The red-ink chit in the lining is the dark secret's proof, which Raum's gate shows.
